Makefile.libretro.summary: Supply the shared libretro engine build and symbol-isolation rules.

openbor.c.summary: Apply the port's engine corrections and select the PC video configuration on macOS. Leave multiplayer slots without a selected model available to join even if game scripts preassign lives to them. Let a missing basename-only PAK self-check read the active frontend content after it has been validated and prepared. Allocate each model's animation pointer table through the highest animation index that model uses, and bound cache, copy and cleanup paths to that capacity. Resize repeated weapon lists and detach borrowed lists before replacing their entries.

openbor.h.summary: Allocate collision pointer slots through the highest author-facing index used by each collection. Track each model's allocated animation-table capacity and reject lookups outside it.

openborscript.c.summary: Keep the dormant constant-lowering diagnostic compatible with the single-value instruction layout.

source/gamelib/borendian.h.summary: Use the port's fixed-width endian conversions.

source/gamelib/draw.c.summary: Route circle drawing through the port's integer rasterizer.

source/gamelib/filecache.c.summary: Expose the cache descriptor for resource restoration and initialize it to -1.

source/gamelib/packfile.c.summary: Repair PAK handles after state loads, close resources on reset, prune unused frontend APIs, and compile the case-insensitive loose-file search on macOS.

source/gamelib/packfile.h.summary: Remove declarations of unused standalone frontend APIs and define O_BINARY where macOS lacks it.

source/gamelib/threads.h.summary: Declare the libretro thread, mutex and condition types.

source/pnglib/savepng.c.summary: Include the standard library declarations instead of the glibc-only <malloc.h> when writing a screenshot.

source/preprocessorlib/pp_parser.c.summary: Drop the glibc-only <malloc.h> and rely on the standard library declarations the parser already includes.

source/ramlib/ram.c.summary: Read host memory statistics through mach on macOS instead of the glibc-only <malloc.h>.

source/scriptlib/ImportCache.c.summary: Guard parser-only import metadata after compilation. Read import metadata only while an interpreter still owns parser state.

source/scriptlib/ImportCache.h.summary: Retain imported entry points as direct instruction pointers.

source/scriptlib/Instruction.c.summary: Store each compiled script constant once, compact call parameter references, and distinguish parser storage from compiled call and jump targets.

source/scriptlib/Instruction.h.summary: Remove redundant value storage, compact opcode and call-reference bookkeeping, and share parser-only fields with their compiled replacements.

source/scriptlib/Interpreter.c.summary: Push canonical constants, release parser-only instruction data, and pack compiled instructions, values, and call references into exact contiguous storage. Allocate parser state only while compiling and release it once runtime instructions are ready.

source/scriptlib/Interpreter.h.summary: Own the exact contiguous storage used by compiled instructions and their values. Store parser state indirectly so compiled interpreters do not retain it.

source/utils.c.summary: Enable libretro platform and PNG helper declarations, the POSIX directory and mkdir forms macOS also uses, and the standard allocation declarations instead of the glibc-only <malloc.h>.

source/webmlib/halloc/LICENSE.summary: Supply the BSD terms referenced by the original halloc headers.

source/webmlib/vidplay.c.summary: Coordinate WebM worker shutdown and yield while waiting for video frames.

version.h.origin: Generated from the pinned source manifest
version.h.summary: Generate the pinned build identity instead of depending on upstream VCS version generation.
